posts.report_reason_placeholder: Optionally add a reason for a moderator…
posts.title_hint: A short headline (up to 120 characters). Leave blank for a body-only post — the list will show your first line of the body instead.
posts.language_hint: The language you're writing this post in. This is only a tag — it is not translated — and it keeps the text findable later and lets a reader add their own language version if they want.
posts.mandatory_title: Everyone in the neighborhood is a member of this community — no one can be removed or leave it.
posts.no_feeds: No community feed is currently available to post to. Ask a resident (or a global admin, if you have one) to enable one — the common ones are safety, maintenance, social, and governance.
posts.new_intro: By default everyone in the community you pick below can see your post. Turn that off in the audience section only if you want to narrow who can see it to specific people or groups.
posts.community_hint: The community decides which feed your post appears in — and, by default, who can see it (every member of that community). To narrow the audience, turn off “Everyone in this community” in the audience section below.
posts.edit_lede: You are editing your own post. Only you can edit it. The community this post appears in is fixed — it cannot be changed after you post; only the title, body, language, and audience below are editable.
posts.edit_no_feed: This post's community feed is no longer available. You can still edit the title, body, and audience below.
posts.community_label_edit: Community (the feed this post appears in — fixed)
posts.community_label_new: Community (the feed this post will appear in)
posts.community_hint_edit: The community only decides which feed your post appears in — it does not decide who can see it, and it is fixed once posted.
posts.audience_heading: Audience — who can see this post
posts.audience_empty_none: With no picks, no one matches, so no one else can see your post — only you (the author) can.
posts.audience_empty_all: With All mode and no picks, no one matches, so no one else can see your post — only you (the author) can.
posts.audience_empty_any: With Any mode and no picks, no one matches, so no one else can see your post — only you (the author) can.
posts.save_as_draft_hint: A draft is saved but visible to no one — not even admins — until you publish it. You can find it under “My drafts”.
posts.draft_note: This post is a draft — only you can see it. Publish it to make it visible under its audience.
posts.audience_all_members_hint: The default — every member of the community above can see this post. Turn it off only if you want to narrow who can see it.
posts.audience_all_members_hint_edit: When on, every member of this community can see the post. Turn it off to narrow the audience to specific people or groups.
posts.audience_restrict_hint: These picks are hidden while “Everyone in this community” is on — the post is visible to everyone in the community. Turn that off to narrow who can see it with the picks here.
posts.audience_only_picks: Whatever you pick here becomes the post's audience — nothing above or below this form is added to it. An empty pick (with “Everyone in this community” off) means only you can see the post.
posts.empty_can_post: No posts yet here. Write the first one — it will be visible only to the audience you choose in the composer below the title.
posts.detail_why: You can see this post because you were allowed to view it — either you're the author, or it was shared with you or your groups.
posts.report_note: Filing a report is an intake action — it doesn't change what you can see, and a moderator may follow up.
posts.replies_empty: No replies yet. If you can see this post, you can reply to it.
posts.reply_heading_author: Reply (you are the author of this post)
posts.reply_language_note: The language you're replying in — a tag, not a translation.
posts.reply_audience_note: Replies have no own audience — they are visible under this post's single audience decision. You are replying only where the post itself is visible.
posts.deleted_placeholder: This post has been deleted by its author.
posts.reply_deleted_placeholder: This reply has been deleted by its author.
posts.delete_confirm: Delete this post? Your replies will remain visible.
posts.reply_delete_confirm: Delete this reply? It will be replaced by a note. The record is kept.
